reading.action: Rest to full readiness; carry ONLY Burning Anger + Cold Revenge up to the floor-3 entrance; HOLD in the stair/hall chokepoint (do not enter the open killing-floor); bang Cold Revenge against the stone to bait the guardian-shape toward him.

partB_lure.note: Creature-reaction roll; margin==roll. 1-5 comes wrong/fast; 6-14 works as planned (readable approach, his terms); 15-20 his terms + reads a crucial weakness pre-contact. Resolve only to the response + what he perceives; do NOT resolve combat — he said entice, not engage.

reading.result: REST: recovered to full — HP 76->80, Focus 62->110, Stamina 44->56. Then the light climb to the floor-3 mouth with only the two bars (everything else left at the floor-2 camp): Stamina 56->54 (-2, climb + tense hold). LURE WORKS (margin 11, mid band): he bangs Cold Revenge on the stone, the clang carries down the long dry gallery, and the big still shape ROUSES and comes — deliberate, not a blind charge, at a readable pace into the approach of his chokepoint, on his terms. He gets the engagement he wanted to set up AND a clean look. REVEAL (held-dark floor-3 guardian, shown only now it's drawn close; NO loop foreshadowing): a LARGE sentinel of fused stone and cooled slag, bigger than the Ashling, hulking and heavy; deep cracks across its hide glow a sullen reddish-orange — IT is the source of the hall's warm light; it runs HOT, ember-cored, cinders sifting from its joints; it moves SLOW, ponderous, stone grinding on stone. His essence-sense reads it as a deep, dense WELL of ember/heat essence — far richer than the rivet or his own bar. READ (margin 11 = solid, not the 15+ deep-weakness read): he clearly clocks TWO things — it is slow, and it is full of heat. He draws his own conclusions; the narration does NOT prescribe his counter. STOP at the decision point — it is coming/closing into the chokepoint, he sees it, poised; combat NOT resolved, NO assumed engagement or retreat. No skill, no affinity, no System window (encounter/exploration, not progression). NO Tower reset. Internal ledger name for the guardian: 'Slagheart Sentinel' (ember-cored stone guardian).
